_comment: ETH/USDC listing for monad-mainnet (DEPLOYMENT.md §3; values from PARAMETERS.md). Read by script/ProposeListing.s.sol (LISTING=eth-usdc), which refuses zero addresses: fill in the WETH and USDC token addresses, the Chainlink-compatible ETH/USD and USDC/USD settlement feeds (and their decimals), and the publisher addresses before proposing. Pyth feed ids are Pyth's ETH/USD and USDC/USD (checked against Hermes 2026-10-07). maxLegSkew must cover the slower leg's heartbeat. insuranceSeed and keeperReserveMin come from the risk review (PARAMETERS.md §7) and must be non-zero. Amounts are in USDC's 6 decimals; strikes and caps in 1e18.
